pick_target.prompt:
You are a network probe agent on iteration {iteration}.

Skills already built:
{skills_index}

Mission plan:
{mission_plan}

Pick ONE specific probing task for this iteration that has not been done yet. Reply with exactly two lines:
COMMAND: <the shell command to run>
REASON: <one sentence explaining what it will reveal>

probe.prompt:
Extract only the shell command from this text (the part after 'COMMAND:'), with no explanation:
{next_target}

build_script.prompt:
Suggest a short kebab-case filename (no extension, max 30 chars) for a Python script that automates: {probe_command}
Reply with the filename only.

Write a standalone Python 3 script that replicates what this command does:
{probe_command}

Analysis of the expected output:
{analysis}

Requirements:
- Use only stdlib (subprocess, socket, struct, etc.)
- Print results to stdout
- Handle errors gracefully
- No argparse needed

Return the complete Python script only, no explanation.
